name: Ollama
summary: Tool to run open models locally or in Ollama's cloud on macOS, Windows and Linux.
description: Ollama lets developers download and run open-weight models locally through a command-line tool, a desktop app and a local API. It also offers cloud-hosted models for larger workloads, and states that prompts are not stored or used for training. The local tool is free. Paid cloud plans start with Pro at $20 per month and Max at $100 per month, which include more usage.

howToUse.title: Open Ollama
howToUse.description: Open Ollama and download the command-line tool or the desktop app so developers can run models on their own machine.

howToUse.title: Run an open-weight model locally
howToUse.description: Download an open-weight model and run it locally through the local API. The local tool is free.

howToUse.title: Move larger workloads to the cloud
howToUse.description: For larger workloads, switch to a cloud-hosted model. Ollama states that prompts are not stored and are not used for training.

howToUse.title: Pick a cloud usage plan
howToUse.description: When local hardware is not enough, compare paid cloud plans. They start with Pro at $20 per month and Max at $100 per month, with more usage on the higher tier.
